message.content:
This document is a technical README/engineering log for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) with experimental AMD HIP support. Key technical points:

## Models & Quantization
- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (320B total/18B active, MIT): Maya quants named by tier (XS/S/M/L by expert bits) — Maya-S (96.5 GB, 97.9% accuracy), S24
